card.name: "May include" in serotonin syndrome symptoms
card.fires_on: The word "include" right after "symptoms may" or "signs and symptoms may" in the serotonin syndrome warning. It comes just before the list starting with mental status changes.

modes.description: The verb "include" that introduces the list of serotonin syndrome symptoms.
